---

**3:1** Woe [hoi] [to the] city of-blood [damim]; all-of-it [kullaha] [is] lies [kachash], plunder [pereq] full [male'ah]; prey [terep] does-not depart [lo yamish].

**3:19** There-is-no [ein] relief [kehah] for-your-hurt [le-shivrekha]; your-wound [makkatekha] [is] grievous [nachalah]. All who-hear [shom'ei] the-report [shim'akha] of-you clap [taq'u] their-hands [khaf] over-you; for upon whom [al-mi] has-not your-evil [ra'atekha] passed [averah] continually [tamid]?
